import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_68/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Step 1: Group by school_name in source1 and calculate average math_score
grouped = source1.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["math_score"].mean()

# Step 2: Join grouped result with source0 on school_name
joined = pd.merge(source0, grouped, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Step 3: Select only the columns required by the target schema
target = joined[["school_name", "math_score"]]

# Convert math_score to float explicitly (should already be float, but to ensure type)
target["math_score"] = target["math_score"].astype(float)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
target.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_68/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
